enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the air conditioner running on a low cool setting during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow under head. Close eyes. Turn onto left side. Place hand under pillow. Bend knees. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature to cool. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea and preparing a light breakfast to eat before the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water from tap. Place kettle on base. Press button to boil. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, bread, eggs. Place items on counter. Take out mug. Place tea bag in mug. Take out plate. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Butter bread. Pour boiled water into mug. Add milk. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, checking the phone for the day's roster and messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Remove pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Check messages. Open roster app. Check roster. Place phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and clinical duties on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Check hand hygiene. Put on gloves. Greet patients. Check vital signs. Administer medications. Change dressings. Assist with mobility. Document in charts. Use computer. Answer phone. Attend team meeting. Monitor patients. Respond to call bells. Consult with colleagues.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal in the staff area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff area. Open locker. Take out packed lunch. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing the work shift, monitoring patients and completing clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Check hand hygiene. Put on gloves. Monitor patients. Check vital signs. Administer medications. Update charts. Use computer. Answer phone. Attend to patient needs. Consult with doctors. Assist with procedures. Document clinical notes. Respond to emergencies. Wash hands.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Remove work clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clean clothes. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner using the microwave and induction cooker to avoid heating the kitchen further
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Open microwave. Put food in microwave. Set timer. Press start. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Cook food. Stir food. Check microwave. Take food out. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading dishes into the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Load cups. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the cooled room, watching TV and using the computer to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Browse internet. Watch TV. Adjust air conditioner. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Turn off TV. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time wash up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone with the air conditioner set for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Pick up phone. Lie on bed. Scroll through phone. Check messages. Watch videos. Set alarm. Turn off light. Adjust air conditioner. Place phone on nightstand. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping ahead of the next work day
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto side. Place hand under pillow. Bend knees. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Continue sleeping.
